Title: 484673-2026: France – Construction work – Creation of an urban higher education campus on the Maret site in Dijon
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: University campus/campus development with extensive refurbishment and complex building tasks makes the project highly relevant for sbp. Deduction because it is located in France (outside the DACH region) and is divided into many smaller lots.
titel: Creation of an urban higher education campus on the Maret site in Dijon
kurzbeschreibung: Conversion and refurbishment of the former CROUS headquarters in Dijon into a shared urban campus for several higher education institutions (including Sciences Po, ENSA Dijon, ESM Bourgogne) with extensive structural rehabilitation, energy and fire safety upgrades, and new communal areas.
wettbewerb_art: Award of construction works (open procedure) for the conversion and refurbishment of a higher education campus
gewinner: Several construction companies per trade, including PENNEQUIN (Lots 1 & 4), R CONSTRUCTION (Lot 2), CEM (Lot 3), PIER (Lots 5 & 6), BS LEDE (Lot 8), MENUISERIE LEBLOND (Lot 9), SMPP (Lot 10), BONGLET (Lot 14), ORONA (Lot 17), SANITEL (Lot 18), DROZ & CIE (Lot 19), EURO SONO ALEX T’REM (Lot 20)
gewinner_rolle: Construction companies for various trades (demolition, structural works, metal construction, fit-out, MEP, etc.)
gewinner_kontakt: Total value of the construction contracts awarded in this notice: 10071599.05 EUR
projektbeteiligte:
Client: Rectorat de la région académique BFC, 10 rue de la Convention, 25000 Besançon, France, E-mail: ce.draa@region-academique-bourgogne-franche-comte.fr, Tel.: +33 380448441.
Construction companies: PENNEQUIN (Lots 1 & 4, stripping/asbestos and lead removal and earthworks/roads and utilities), R CONSTRUCTION (Lot 2, demolition/structural works/steel structure), CEM (Lot 3, timber structure), PIER (Lots 5 & 6, landscaping and façade cleaning/refurbishment), BS LEDE (Lot 8, waterproofing), MENUISERIE LEBLOND (Lot 9, external timber windows/shutters), SMPP (Lot 10, internal partitions/linings/suspended ceilings), BONGLET (Lot 14, painting/signage), ORONA (Lot 17, lifts), SANITEL (Lot 18, heating/ventilation/sanitary), DROZ & CIE (Lot 19, heavy and light current/fire alarm system), EURO SONO ALEX T’REM (Lot 20, scenographic equipment).
Subcontractors: DAUPHINE ISOLATION ENVIRONNEMENT (Lot 1), EIFFAGE ENERGIE SYSTEMES INFRASTRUCTURES EST (Lot 5), GAUDRY BTP (Lot 5).
Review body: Tribunal Administratif de Dijon, 22 rue d'Assas, 21000 Dijon, France, E-mail: greffe.ta-dijon@juradm.fr.
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Conversion and refurbishment of an existing higher education building complex, no new build with exceptional structural complexity apparent
- Award concerns pure construction works; structural design has already been completed and is not part of the notice
- Project is outside the DACH region and without bridge or long-span special structures
- For sbp as structural engineer, rather limited strategic relevance
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- French project, checking engineer services according to the German system are not applicable
- Conversion/refurbishment of a higher education campus without indications of exceptional structural risks or large spans
- Structural design and approval processes in France are already established; no explicit need for independent structural checking apparent
baukosten_erklaerung: Read off or roughly estimated: total award volume 10.07 million EUR for construction works, of which approx. 70–80% is assumed to fall under cost groups 300/400
naechste_schritte: No active involvement recommended; only record the project in internal monitoring as a reference for French higher education refurbishments.
notes: This is a construction contract award notice, not an architectural or planning competition. Structural design is not part of the tender and is likely already awarded. The lots mainly cover execution trades (demolition, structural works, fit-out, MEP, external works). No link to watchlist projects and no bridge or stadium components apparent.
